description: The shared rules (digest pinning, the 14-day minimumReleaseAge with timestamp-optional, and the managers for the mise version in workflows and for versions named in mise.toml's [env]) come from the iglootools base preset, pinned to a release tag: see guidelines/project-setup/dependency-automation.md in iglootools/common. Grouping comes from Nuxt's preset and group:all; what is below is this project's own.

packageRules.description: Replacement and pin updates carry no release timestamp, so the release-age check can never be satisfied and would leave renovate/stability-days pending forever. security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm exempts these for npm; we do the same for all datasources. lockFileMaintenance is exempted in its own config block below.

Hold TypeScript inside typescript-eslint's peer range, which is `>=4.8.4 <6.1.0` (seven packages in pnpm-lock.yaml declare it). typescript-eslint reaches us transitively via @nuxt/eslint -> @nuxt/eslint-config, so we cannot bump it independently; forcing TS7 crashes eslint with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'Cjs')". The bound is <6.1 rather than <7 so it tracks the peer range itself instead of merely excluding the next major -- TS 6.1 would violate the peer range too. This rule only constrains what renovate proposes, so the devDependency is `~6.0.3` rather than `^6.0.3`; otherwise lockFileMaintenance would resolve 6.1 inside the caret range and bypass this entirely. Lift the bound and widen the range together once typescript-eslint widens its peer: `npm view typescript-eslint peerDependencies`.

Hold @nuxt/fonts inside the range @nuxt/ui depends on, which is `^0.14.0`. @nuxt/ui installs @nuxt/fonts itself, resolved from its own dependency, while our `modules` entry in nuxt.config.ts resolves the copy declared here; a newer major leaves two copies in the tree and both register as modules. The declaration is exact (`0.14.0`), so lockFileMaintenance cannot move it either. Lift the bound once @nuxt/ui widens its dependency: `npm view @nuxt/ui dependencies.@nuxt/fonts`.

Hold the mdast-util-to-markdown override in pnpm-workspace.yaml at 2.1.2: from 2.1.3 remark-mdc recurses forever stringifying bold and italic text, /llms-full.txt returns 500, and the build fails (nuxt-content/remark-mdc#161). Without this rule Renovate bumps the override in the grouped PR and, rewriting the YAML, deletes the comment that explains the hold. Remove this rule together with the override once remark-mdc ships a fix: `npm view remark-mdc version`.
